description:
Alcoholism is the only disease that convinces you every single day that you do not have it.

Davinia Taylor describes what coming off alcohol actually feels like in the body, that stone dropping in the stomach that most people only experience in their worst moments of grief or shock, felt every three to four minutes, constantly, regardless of what the last drink was like.

Most people have never been asked to understand what that physiology actually demands of a person, and that silence is a large part of why the lie keeps working.

Comment DAVINIA and I'll send you the full conversation.

#MarisaPeer #DaviniaTaylor #Alcoholism #Sobriety #MentalHealth
transcript: What's the biggest lie we're told about alcoholism? It is the only disease that will convince you you've not got it on a daily basis and that next time is going to be different. Even though I know the last drink was skin crawling terror, it's exactly the same sinking feeling as I got when I was at the Christie Hospital with my mum and the oncologist said, you've got six months left to live. That sinking feeling of sheer fear and terror is what happens every three to four minutes Thanks for watching! hospital with my mom and the oncologist said you've got six months left to live that sinking feeling of sheer fear and terror is what happens every three to four minutes as you're coming off alcohol if you hear terrible news or you read a terrible email that that stone dropping in your stomach that's what you feel but it's constant regardless of what the last time you drank
